There's little tree canopy overhead as this area consists of smaller trees and much shrubbery. ==Getting there== [[The Defenders of the Forest]] is the [[primary quest]] that will lead characters through this area. Drazach Thicket lies between [[Saint Anjeka's Shrine]], [[Brauer Academy]], and [[The Eternal Grove (outpost)|the Eternal Grove]]. ==Exits== *[[Brauer Academy]] (east; 2 exits) *[[The Eternal Grove
